_note: EXPERIMENTAL example. Koios documents tx_info only as POST with a JSON body (koiosapi.yaml v1.4.2). The GET form below works because Koios runs on PostgREST, but it is undocumented and may change. Prefer a provider with a documented GET transaction endpoint for production use (e.g. Blockfrost GET /txs/{hash}, which needs a project key).

endpoints.summary: EXPERIMENTAL: transaction details by hash (undocumented GET form of Koios tx_info)

parameters.name: _tx_hashes
parameters.description: PostgREST array of transaction hashes, e.g. {hash}
